rows.grounds: compound indicating the starting point of the sequence; mūla-mantra as the initial element
prescribes the ritual action to be carried out
instrumental compound denoting the complete set of mantras used in performance

items.question: What mantra sequence must be employed when performing the prescribed ritual action?
premises: The ritual action is to be performed.
The performance begins with the root mantra.
The performance includes the entire group of mantras.
items.inference: Therefore, the practitioner should perform the ritual action starting with the root mantra and using the entire mantra group.
uncertainties: The specific identity and composition of the sarva-mantra-gaṇa is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: One should indeed perform the rite beginning with the root mantra and using the entire group of mantras.
